title: Google\Cloud\Talent\V4beta1\ProfileEvent
name: ProfileEvent
description: An event issued when a profile searcher interacts with the application that implements Cloud Talent Solution.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.profiles
params.description: Required. The [profile name(s)][google.cloud.talent.v4beta1.Profile.name] associated with this client event. The format is "projects/{project_id}/tenants/{tenant_id}/profiles/{profile_id}", for example, "projects/foo/tenants/bar/profiles/baz".

params.name: data.jobs
params.description: The [job name(s)][google.cloud.talent.v4beta1.Job.name] associated with this client event. Leave it empty if the event isn't associated with a job. The format is "projects/{project_id}/tenants/{tenant_id}/jobs/{job_id}", for example, "projects/foo/tenants/bar/jobs/baz".

methods.name: getProfiles
methods.description: Required. The [profile name(s)][google.cloud.talent.v4beta1.Profile.name] associated with this client event.

methods.name: setProfiles
methods.description: Required. The [profile name(s)][google.cloud.talent.v4beta1.Profile.name] associated with this client event.

methods.name: getJobs
methods.description: The [job name(s)][google.cloud.talent.v4beta1.Job.name] associated with this client event. Leave it empty if the event isn't associated with a job.

methods.name: setJobs
methods.description: The [job name(s)][google.cloud.talent.v4beta1.Job.name] associated with this client event. Leave it empty if the event isn't associated with a job.
